question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Last Burden'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Upamanyu Chatterjee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Upamanyu Chatterjee** is an Indian author and civil servant, known for his contribution to contemporary Indian literature in English.
 
• He wrote the book **'The Last Burden'**, which was published in 1993.
 
• Upamanyu Chatterjee's writing often explores themes related to Indian middle-class life and society.
 
• His debut novel, **'English, August: An Indian Story'**, is highly acclaimed and has been adapted into a film.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Upamanyu Chatterjee's Literary Style**

 
 
• His writing style is known for its wit, humor, and satirical take on Indian bureaucracy and society.
 
• He often uses vivid descriptions and complex characters to portray the intricacies of Indian life.
 
 
 
• **'English, August: An Indian Story'**
 
 
• Published in 1988, this novel is considered a classic in modern Indian literature.
 
• It tells the story of a young Indian bureaucrat's experiences in a small town.
 
 
 
• **Indian Authors in English Literature**
 
 
• Authors like R.K. Narayan, Arundhati Roy, and Jhumpa Lahiri have also contributed significantly to this genre.
 
• Their works often deal with themes of post-colonial identity, cultural conflicts, and the diaspora experience.
 
 
 
• **The Role of Literature in Reflecting Society**
 
 
• Literature serves as a mirror to society, offering insights into the cultural, social, and political landscapes.
 
• It can influence public opinion and bring attention to societal issues and injustices.
